description: This file defines an AuthProvider class for managing authentication tokens in a Flutter application. It handles storing, retrieving, and persisting tokens, and provides placeholder methods for login and registration.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A Flutter ChangeNotifier class responsible for managing authentication token state, storing it persistently, and providing authentication status checks.

methods.name: token
methods.description: Getter for the current authentication token.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Returns true if an authentication token is present and not empty.

methods.name: loadToken
methods.description: Loads the stored token from SharedPreferences asynchronously and updates state.

methods.name: _saveToken
methods.description: Persists the current token to SharedPreferences; removes it if null or empty.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Sets a new token value and persists it, then notifies listeners.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the token and updates persistent storage, then notifies listeners.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Placeholder method for user login; currently returns false and prints debug info.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Placeholder method for user registration; currently returns false and prints debug info.
